mapper.select: SELECT ds.id FROM duty_shift ds WHERE ds.operational_period_id = #{opId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND ds.police_phone_id = #{policePhoneId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND ds.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY ds.started_at DESC, ds.id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ds.id FROM duty_shift ds JOIN incident_assignment ia ON ia.id = ds.incident_assignment_id WHERE ds.operational_period_id = #{opId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND ia.account_id = #{accountId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND ia.revoked_at IS NULL AND ds.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY ds.started_at DESC, ds.id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ia.account_id FROM duty_shift ds JOIN incident_assignment ia ON ia.id = ds.incident_assignment_id WHERE ds.operational_period_id = #{opId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND ds.police_phone_id = #{policePhoneId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND ds.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY ds.started_at DESC, ds.id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO search_path ( id, duty_shift_id, account_id, status, started_at, ended_at, geometry, version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{dutyShiftId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{accountId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{status}, #{startedAt}, #{endedAt}, ST_GeomFromEWKT(#{geometry,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.JtsGeometryTypeHandler}), #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE search_path SET status = #{status}, account_id = #{accountId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, ended_at = #{endedAt}, geometry = ST_GeomFromEWKT(#{geometry,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.JtsGeometryTypeHandler}), version = #{version}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO search_path_lifecycle_event ( id, search_path_id, event_type, client_ts, server_received_at, actor_police_phone_id, version, created_at ) VALUES ( #{id,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{searchPathId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{eventType}, #{clientTs}, #{serverReceivedAt}, #{actorPolicePhoneId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{version}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, search_path_id, event_type, client_ts, server_received_at, actor_police_phone_id, version, created_at FROM search_path_lifecycle_event WHERE search_path_id = #{pathId,typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} ORDER BY version ASC, client_ts ASC, id ASC
mapper.sql: sp.id, op.incident_id, ds.operational_period_id AS op_id, sp.duty_shift_id, COALESCE(started_event.actor_police_phone_id, ds.police_phone_id) AS police_phone_id, sp.account_id, sp.status, sp.started_at, sp.ended_at, ST_AsEWKT(sp.geometry) AS geometry, sp.version, sp.created_at, sp.updated_at

FROM search_path sp JOIN duty_shift ds ON ds.id = sp.duty_shift_id JOIN operational_period op ON op.id = ds.operational_period_id LEFT JOIN search_path_lifecycle_event started_event ON started_event.search_path_id = sp.id AND started_event.event_type = 'STARTED' AND started_event.version = 1
